description: This file contains the implementation of the InsideRuntimeClient class which handles internal runtime messaging, request/response processing, callback management, and lifecycle participation within the Orleans runtime system.

classes.name: InsideRuntimeClient
classes.description: Internal class managing runtime messaging, request handling, callback registration, and lifecycle for Orleans system grains.

methods.name: SendRequest
methods.description: Constructs and sends a request message to a target grain, registering callback if needed.

methods.name: SendResponse
methods.description: Sends a response message back through the message center.

methods.name: UnregisterCallback
methods.description: Removes callback data associated with a specific grain and message correlation ID.

methods.name: SniffIncomingMessage
methods.description: Inspects incoming messages for cache invalidation and other metadata updates.

methods.name: Invoke
methods.description: Handles invocation of messages, including executing grain methods and generating responses.

methods.name: SafeSendResponse
methods.description: Attempts to send a response, catching and logging exceptions.

methods.name: SafeSendExceptionResponse
methods.description: Attempts to send an exception response, handling errors gracefully.

methods.name: ReceiveResponse
methods.description: Processes incoming response messages, matching with callbacks, handling status updates and rejections.

methods.name: CreateObjectReference
methods.description: Creates an object reference for an addressable object, only if not in a grain context.

methods.name: DeleteObjectReference
methods.description: Deletes an object reference, only if not in a grain context.

methods.name: Participate
methods.description: Subscribes the client to the silo lifecycle to manage runtime start and stop activities.

methods.name: BreakOutstandingMessagesToSilo
methods.description: Flags outstanding messages targeting a dead silo for failure handling.
